text: Mia's dad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is 2 November 2026 at St Mary's, 11am. Remind me to send flowers before then.
elif got a puppy!! cockapoo called biscuit, 10 wks old. she's knackered already lol
Hugo's housewarming Saturday June 3rd, new place in Leith. Bringing wine. Ask him if Lior is coming.

So I just got off the phone with Heather and um she was made redundant on Friday, the whole team basically, she's pretty shaken but she's got some savings and she said her husband's being really good about it. She's going to start looking properly in March 2027 once the payout comes through. I should check in with her next week.
Ines + Mila engagement dinner May 14, at the Thai place on Crown St
akira's cat Miso had her op yday, teeth out. home now, groggy

Emil and his girlfriend split up. Been together 6 yrs. He's moving back in with his parents for a bit while they sort out selling the flat, which could take till March 2027 the way the market is. He said the worst part is she's keeping their dog Hector. He sounded tired but ok. Going to see a band with him on the 14th to get him out.
Theo turns 40 on 5/14. Party at his brother's. Theo said he'd love a decent bottle of whisky, Lagavulin maybe
Don't forget to ask Rohan how the vet appointment went for his dog Pepper.
Bought train tickets for the 2nd. Need to pick up dry cleaning before Thursday.
James and Nasser are having people round for dinner on the 21st. Their kids will be at their nan's. I'm doing dessert.
Eduardo's grandmother died last week, he's flying out to Lisbon for the funeral on June 3rd. Must message him before he goes.
Adebayo's leaving drinks were meant to be Friday but they're called off, he's been asked to stay on another month. New date probably mid March 2027.
caitlin nervous about hosting her in laws for christmas dinner. first time. she's vegetarian and they're very much not
Lila's rabbit Clover died this morning. She's gutted, had her since uni. Send her something nice.

Anya's 30th, 2 November 2026, warehouse thing in Hackney. Fancy dress, theme is 'iconic duos'. Arjun and I are going as Wallace and Gromit apparently, which means I'm the dog. Anya's sister Lila is doing the playlist and said Anya has been eyeing up a vintage record player for ages, so maybe we all chip in for that.
Shira invited me to her Rosh Hashanah dinner last month, never thanked her properly. remind me to drop round a card
Rana's mum is in hospice. They think weeks not months. Rana's taking leave from work from Monday.
Aditi got made redundant. Heard it from Fiona not her so don't bring it up unless she does.
Marcus loves rescue greyhounds, has two, Dot and Pip. Volunteers with the charity on weekends

Ok so recap from Mehmet's barbecue: Seo-yeon is pregnant, due May 14 2027, first one. Mohammed has started at the new firm and hates the commute, two hours each way. Jack's dog Rolo is turning one on June 3rd and apparently there's going to be a dog party, I'm not joking. Mehmet's wife Nora asked if I'd come to her book club. Remind me to get Seo-yeon a little something.
Alejandro and Nora broke up. Amicable apparently. Nora keeping the flat and the cat.
Dinner at Hugo's next Fri, 7:30. He's doing paella
Mia said the funeral went as well as it could. Her brother Theo gave the eulogy and held it together. I should ask how her mum's coping.
Bin day moved to Tuesdays from next week.
Elif says biscuit chewed through the skirting board. Puppy classes start 5/14
Heather's interview with the council went ok she thinks. Hear back by end of the month. Fingers crossed
lior's having a leaving do for his job at the bank. friday 6/3. pub near liverpool st

Talked to Ines on the phone for ages. She's really struggling since her dad's funeral, not sleeping. Her sister Mila is staying with her for a bit. I need to call her again on Sunday and maybe suggest the grief group her GP mentioned.
Akira loves Studio Ghibli and is learning to make ramen from scratch
emil's birthday drinks off this wk, he's not up to it. maybe later in the month
Theo hinted he wants one of those fancy pet cameras for when he's at work. His cat Nugget gets anxious
Rohan and his wife are hosting Diwali party, Nov 1st 2026. Bring sweets. Their twins are performing a dance
Gym at 6 then groceries. Call the landlord re boiler
James's uncle passed. Funeral private, family only. He seemed ok but quiet
Nasser invited us to his 50th, March 2027, he's booking a villa in Portugal for a long weekend. Need to sort time off
Remind me to ask Eduardo how the move went, they got the keys on May 14.

Adebayo's daughter graduates on June 3rd and they're having a garden party after. He's so proud. She did law at Leeds and already has a training contract lined up for September. His wife is doing jollof for about forty people and he says the whole family is flying in from Lagos, including his aunt who he hasn't seen since 2019.

So Caitlin's cat, the big ginger one, Marmalade, is really poorly, kidney stuff, vet says it might be time. She's taking him in Thursday to decide. She's been crying all week. I should drop round on Wednesday evening with food, and don't forget she's allergic to nuts.
Lila's housewarming 2 November 2026!! finally got the flat. Her girlfriend Anya is doing a whole cheese board
Arjun got laid off last Tuesday along with half of engineering. Already has two interviews lined up for the week of 5/14. He's weirdly upbeat about it
Shira's puppy Bagel comes home tomorrow. She's beside herself
Rana mentioned she's really into pottery now, does a class Wednesday nights. Wants a wheel for her birthday
Aditi + her husband are celebrating 10 yrs married with a dinner on June 3rd. Remind me to book the sitter

Fiona's mum's funeral is Monday 2 November 2026 at 2pm, Golders Green crematorium. Wake at the Spaniards after. Fiona asked if I could do a reading. I said yes. Need to pick one this weekend and email it to her by Friday.
Marcus nervous about his first dinner party, he's cooking for 8 on Saturday. Asked me for a dessert recipe

Mehmet's dog Kebab (yes really) had to be put down yesterday. 14 years old. Mehmet's in bits, he got him the week he moved to London. His kids keep asking when Kebab is coming home. He said they might get another dog in the spring but not yet. Don't forget to send a card to the whole family, something not too soppy.
saw seo-yeon at the shop. she's off sugar, doing some challenge til the end of march
Mohammed asked if I'm free for iftar on March 3rd 2027. His mum's cooking for everyone. Say yes!!
Jack's engagement party was cancelled, him and his fiancee Nora Barros are taking a break. He didn't want to talk about it much
Alejandro's brother is getting married 5/14 in Mexico City. Alejandro is best man and terrified about the speech. Ask him to send me the draft
Mia Gupta from work invited me to her leaving lunch. Tuesday. She's off to Berlin.
Hugo's dog Bruno is having surgery on his knee on the 14th. Remind me to text Hugo that morning
Need to renew passport before March 2027, check the photo rules
Elif's mum turns 70 on June 3rd 2027 and Elif wants to throw a surprise dinner. I'm on invites. Need to get the list from her sister Ines.
Rohan's grandad passed away peacefully last night. He was 96. Rohan says the funeral will probably be early next week
Dr Petrov is retiring end of March 2027 so Heather's practice is having a do for him. Heather's organising
Theo, or Teddy as his mates call him, said his lab Juno just had six puppies. He's keeping one

had dinner at Nasser and Emil's last night, lovely. Emil does amazing bread, he's thinking about a baking course in the spring. Nasser was quieter than usual, his company is doing redundancies on May 14 and he doesn't know yet if he's on the list. They've also just booked Japan for March 2027 so the timing is awful.

Note to self: Lior has been having a rough time since the redundancy in September. He's applying for everything. His partner Akira says he's barely sleeping. I should invite him to the pub quiz on Thursday and not mention jobs at all, just let him have a night off.
